title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
content_snippet: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
title_zh: 能常驻短信的顶级 AI 代理一览
summary_zh: 盘点了一系列可通过短信交互的知名 AI 代理，涵盖通用助手、家庭、旅行及工作等场景。
key_points: 盘点可通过短信交互的各类 AI 代理

title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
content_snippet: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.
title_zh: 将面部 AI 授权给微短剧初创公司是未来吗？
summary_zh: 一名演员将其面部授权给微短剧初创公司，引发对好莱坞未来可能趋势及长期后果的讨论。
key_points: 演员将面部授权给 AI 微短剧公司
引发对好莱坞未来 AI 应用趋势的探讨
专家担忧此模式可能带来的长期影响

title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
content_snippet: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to […]
title_zh: Anthropic 能否坚持安全优先？
summary_zh: 探讨 Anthropic 上市后，在巨大商业压力下能否继续将 AI 安全置于首要位置。

title: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
content_snippet: Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku, solitaire, xiangqi, and a Scrabble alternative called word. They're all part of Chess's new Classic Games platform, which is launching […]
title_zh: Chess.com 的下一步：打造经典游戏中心
summary_zh: Chess.com 扩展业务，新增麻将、数独等 10 款经典游戏，打造一站式棋牌娱乐平台。
key_points: Chess.com 新增十款经典游戏，包括麻将和数独
旨在从象棋平台扩展为一站式经典游戏中心
此前的扑克产品 Gambit 已取得成功

content_snippet: Director Takashi Yamazaki ups the ante by pitting Godzilla against one of the monster's greatest foes

title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
content_snippet: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
title_zh: Signal限制手机截图，应对AI监控的“生存威胁”
summary_zh: Signal正在其安卓和iOS应用中限制用户的截图能力，以应对人工智能监控带来的所谓“生存威胁”，增强通讯隐私保护。
key_points: Signal限制安卓与iOS端的截图功能以增强隐私
此举旨在直接对抗AI监控带来的生存威胁
这是加密通讯应用应对AI时代风险的最新举措

title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
content_snippet: One of the items on the agenda for UN diplomats meeting in Geneva this week was working towards rules regarding the use of autonomous weapons, or so-called "killer robots." Eventually, representatives left the meetings agreeing to "start discussing options" after a largely fruitless week of negotiations. According to NPR: Before the negotiations got underway, the […]
title_zh: 联合国未能就“杀手机器人”监管规则达成一致
summary_zh: 在日内瓦举行的联合国会议中，各国外交官未能就自主武器的使用规则达成一致，仅同意“开始讨论选项”，谈判进程基本无果而终。
key_points: 联合国会议未能就监管自主武器达成一致
各方仅同意开始讨论未来的潜在选项
谈判在历经一周后仍基本毫无成果
